Super Bowl Transportation Phoenix: Complete Game Day Guide

When the Super Bowl comes to the Valley, Phoenix, Glendale and Scottsdale turn into one giant sports festival. More than 100,000 visitors arrive in a single week, and getting between hotels, parties and State Farm Stadium becomes the difference between a great trip and a long one. Here is how to move through Super Bowl week like a VIP, with real vehicles and real hourly rates.

Why Super Bowl Transportation Matters

State Farm Stadium in Glendale is a challenge on a normal Cardinals Sunday. On Super Bowl Sunday, multiply that by ten. The rideshare fare is whatever the app says when you request it, post-game waits stretch well past an hour, and the designated pickup zones sit a long walk from the gates. Parking lots fill before noon, and the walk from remote lots can top a mile in a crowd.

Professional transportation is not a luxury during Super Bowl week. It is the plan.

Super Bowl Week Event Calendar

The game is the finale. The week around it is packed with events:

  • Wednesday to Thursday: Fan festival events at the Phoenix Convention Center
  • Thursday: Media events across downtown
  • Friday: Awards shows and league hospitality
  • Saturday: Fan events and the biggest parties of the year in Old Town Scottsdale
  • Sunday: Tailgates, pre-game festivities and kickoff

Each stop needs its own transportation plan. Many of our clients keep one vehicle for the whole week so the group moves together from event to event.

State Farm Stadium Logistics

The Venue Challenge

State Farm Stadium sits in Glendale's Westgate Entertainment District, roughly 20 miles from central Scottsdale and 15 miles from downtown Phoenix. On game day:

  • Official lots open several hours before kickoff
  • Premium lots are a short walk from the gates; general lots are much farther
  • Exit traffic takes two to three hours to clear

Our Drop-Off Strategy

Our professional, licensed chauffeurs know the designated drop-off zones and the approach routes that avoid the worst backups. We stage vehicles so the group is rolling shortly after leaving their seats, and your chauffeur texts you the exact pickup spot before the fourth quarter ends.

The Party Bus Advantage

For groups of 15 to 28, the Party Bus (28 Pax) turns game day into one continuous event:

  • Pre-game: Climate-controlled tailgating with your own music
  • During the game: Your gear stays secure in the vehicle
  • Post-game: You leave when you are ready, no waiting in a rideshare pen
  • Cost per person: Known in writing before the day

A 10-hour Super Bowl Sunday on the Party Bus (28 Pax) bills 9 hours (one free) for $2,250 before tax, or $2,430 with tax. Split among 20 friends that is about $113 per person; fill all 28 seats and it drops to about $80 per person.

Executive Sprinter for Corporate Groups

The 14-seat Executive Sprinter is the corporate favorite. A 10-hour game day is $1,305 plus 8% tax, about $93 per person with 14 on board. Leather seating, phone charging and room to talk business on the way to Glendale.

Luxury SUV (Suburban) for Small Groups

For up to 6 guests, the Luxury SUV runs $125/hr with a 4-hour minimum. A 10-hour game day is $1,125 before tax ($1,215 with tax). Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately.

Super Bowl Party Transportation

The parties are half the experience.

Saturday Night Events

Scottsdale hosts the most exclusive Super Bowl parties of the week: celebrity-hosted events in Old Town, player parties at the big nightclubs and corporate hospitality across the Valley. A 6-hour Saturday night on the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $1,500 before tax ($1,620 with tax), about $54 per person for a full load.

Drinking on Board

Yes, adults can drink on board. Arizona's open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine. It is BYOB, everyone drinking must be 21 or older, and the driver never drinks. If anyone on board is under 21, no alcohol at all. You can read the full explainer.

Sunday Tailgate Transfers

Many groups tailgate at a hotel or a private home before heading to the stadium. We handle pickup from any Valley location, cooler and gear transport, flexible timing and the return trip to the tailgate or hotel afterward.

Hotel Transportation

Every resort in Scottsdale, Paradise Valley and North Phoenix is a single freeway run to State Farm Stadium: the 101 west, then Glendale Avenue or the 60.

Game-day traffic roughly doubles the run, which is why a dedicated chauffeur beats an unfamiliar rental.

Corporate Entertainment

Hosting clients or employees? A typical Super Bowl corporate day includes morning airport pickups (a one-way Executive Sprinter airport run is $295 before tax, flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included), hotel transfers, stadium service with a dedicated pickup, a post-game hospitality transfer and late-night hotel returns. For larger groups we coordinate multiple vehicles with synchronized pickups and one point of contact.

Booking Timeline and Cancellation

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open.

Super Bowl week is a major-event date for any year the game is played in the Valley. Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. You get one free date change when you ask 72 or more hours ahead. If we ever cancel, you are refunded in full. See the full policy at /policies.

What to Expect on Game Day

Pre-Game

  • Morning: Relaxed hotel departure or tailgate pickup
  • Midday: Arrive in the stadium area three to four hours early
  • Afternoon: Drop-off at the designated zone, chauffeur positions for the exit

Post-Game

  • Text your chauffeur as you leave your seat
  • Walk to the pre-arranged pickup spot
  • Cold water waiting, then the exit route the locals use

Beyond the Stadium

Extend the trip:

  • Golf at TPC Scottsdale, home of the WM Phoenix Open
  • Old Town dining and nightlife
  • Verde Valley wine tours
  • Grand Canyon day trips
